control_profile: funding-extreme threshold, price-flow confirmation, downward volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, close-confirmed loss stop and one-way turnover cap
falsifier: Extreme settled funding continues rather than unwinds, confirmation arrives too late for next-open execution, or base and stressed costs make both long and short roles nonpositive.
formation_horizon: latest settled funding event standardized against forty-two prior events with three completed confirmation bars
hypothesis: An extreme settled funding observation identifies crowded positioning, and an aligned market-residual price and taker-flow move confirms an unwind that persists beyond the next executable open.
rebalance_horizon: one daily event cohort with three equally weighted overlapping cohorts
